title_vi: Tự truyện của Frederick Douglass, một nô lệ người Mỹ
translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Douglass’s disciplined, ironic and restrained rhetoric is rendered in clear, dignified Vietnamese; scenes of violence are rendered plainly, without softening or sensationalising.
decisions.rationale: The testimony’s force comes from plainness.

decisions.decision: Garrison’s Preface and Phillips’s letter are excluded as other authors’ framing; the book proper (Chapters I–XI) and the Appendix are the translated text.
decisions.rationale: The work is Douglass’s own narrative; the framing texts can be added in a separate, attributed edition.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: ‘master of the vessel’ rendered as the ship’s owner; corrected to the captain.
‘breeder’ rendered ‘con đẻ’ and ‘adopted slaveholders’ rendered as adoption; both corrected (units 93 and 84).
The counterfactual ‘thousands who now remain would escape’ read as if they already had; restored.
The parody hymn lost all its rhyme and jingle; it was recomposed as rhymed verse keeping every line’s sense.
‘hắn’ made the overseer the man whipping Aunt Hester where the source’s ‘he’ is the master; corrected.
Calques, address forms (Hugh, Thomas), terms for God and Christianity and the censored-oath dashes were unified.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.draft_rendering: Thiên Chúa / Kitô hữu / Kitô giáo
glossary.rationale: One Catholic-register convention for the whole book, which also carries Douglass’s irony about slaveholding ‘Christians’.
Roles are kept distinct so that pronouns such as ‘he’ in the whipping scene refer to the right man.
The Lloyd plantation’s name, kept as a proper name.

glossary.draft_rendering: kẻ chuyên điều phục nô lệ; slurs rendered harshly only in whites’ speech
glossary.rationale: The slurs belong to the slaveholders’ speech and are not softened; the narrator’s own usage stays neutral.

witness_decision: Selected Project Gutenberg #23, an electronic transcription of Narrative of the Life of Frederick Douglass, an American Slave. Written by Himself (Boston: Anti-Slavery Office, 1845). The page does not name the exact printing; the text was not collated with the 1845 first edition.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Unit 165 carries one line break fewer than the source because of an OCR artefact (‘they,v’) in the printed text.
